description: Get a project lane's resolutions and run strategy: the resolutions every test case that picks none of its own is verified at, one run each, and how those runs start. Response shape: { projectId, runEnvironmentType, primaryResolution, compatibleResolutions, enabledResolutions, runStrategy }. runStrategy is primaryOnly (the primary runs alone; compatible resolutions are reported as not run), primaryFirst (compatible resolutions run once the primary passes) or allAtOnce (every resolution runs at once); a lane that never set one reports primaryOnly. enabledResolutions are those a test case on the lane may pick. Change them with primaryResolution, compatibleResolutions and runStrategy on muggle-remote-project-update.

runEnvironmentType.description: Lane to read: 'remote' (cloud runs, the default) or 'local' (developer localhost).

name: muggle-remote-project-display-resolutions-get
